definitions.explanation: The farthest end of a place, or the final point or outcome of a process. Usually follows a noun linked with の.

examples.english: What could there be at the edge of the universe?

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧になった。
examples.english: At the end of a long debate, the plan was called off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悩|なや}んだ→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧{挙|あ}げ{句|く}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めてしまった。
examples.english: After agonizing over it, in the end he quit the company.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地|ち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}て: the ends of the earth
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}て: the end of the world
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at the end of ~ (after a long process)
- {挙|あ}げ{句|く}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}て: in the end, to top it all (usually of a bad outcome)
- {成|な}れの{果|は}て: what someone has become (a sad ruin of their former self)

COMMON PATTERNS:
{果|は}て is the noun from {果|は}てる (to come to an end, to be used up), which also forms compounds such as ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧{果|は}てる (to be exhausted).
